releaseReadmeExcerpt:
NANOGrav 11-year data set residuals & DM variations.  Version 1.0, 2018-June-07.


This bundle of files gives the timing residuals and DM variations of NANOGrav
Cbservations and analysis of 45 pulsars in the NANOGrav 11-Year Data Set.
This is the numerical data plotted in figures 7 through 51 of the following 
paper.

  The NANOGrav 11-Year Data Set: High-Precision Timing of 45 Millisecond Pulsars
  Arzoumanian et al 2018, ApJS 235: 37
  doi:10.3847/1538-4365/aab5b0
  arXiv:1801.01837

The year values (horizontal positions) of points in the figures in the paper
are shifted by approximately +0.09 years from their true values.  The correct
values are in the files in this distribution.

The full set of pulse arrival times and pulsar timing models for this data set
is available from http://data.nanograv.org and is also available from ApJS as
supplemental material to the paper.

We caution against using pulsar timing residuals for high-accuracy
astrophysical studies.  The values of residuals are highly dependent on the
timing model used to generate them.  They have, in effect, undergone filtering
due to each parameter included in the timing model fit to the data.  For
astrophysical studies involving phenomena not incorporated into the timing
models used to calculate these residuals, we recommend re-fitting the timing
measurements to all of the standard timing model parameters simultaneously
